'''Electrocharger Model A-2''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|<b>ATK</b>: {{Color|20625|7}}
<b>Attack Interval</b>: {{Color|5|7}}s
<b>Mode of Attack</b>: Releases electrical arcs that attack enemies. The arc chains to nearby enemies (up to 2) and deals {{Color|Electric DMG|6}}. The arc also leaves an electric orb close to the enemy. The orb continuously deals {{Color|Electric DMG|6}} to nearby enemies.|An improvement of the original Surge Tower based on an experimental prototype from RAYTHEAN Industries. When the land courses with electricity, nothing will ever block your path.}}
